newsitem.title: CHINA: Trading in Tomei shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Tomei shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Tomei International (Holdings) Ltd was suspended on Thursday afternoon at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
Tomei shares rose HK$0.25 or 38.46 percent to HK$0.90 at midday. Volume was 124.64 million shares worth HK$100.82 million.
Tomei had said earlier TCL Electronics Group had contacted the company some time ago to explore business opportunities but added it was not in talks to sell a stake to TCL.

The company had said it made the statement in response to press reports saying TCL was studying a proposal to acqyure a controlling stake in Tomei by injecting television joint venture into the company in return for Tomei shares.
